billing_document_lines_trip_posting_chec.name: billing_document_lines_trip_posting_check
billing_document_lines_trip_posting_chec.value:
("billing_document_lines"."financial_posting_id" is null
      and "billing_document_lines"."financial_posting_version" is null
      and "billing_document_lines"."posting_checksum" is null) or (
      "billing_document_lines"."source_type" = 'TRIP'
      and "billing_document_lines"."financial_posting_id" is not null
      and "billing_document_lines"."financial_posting_version" is not null
      and "billing_document_lines"."financial_posting_version" > 0
      and "billing_document_lines"."posting_checksum" is not null
    )

billing_document_lines_vat_consistency_c.name: billing_document_lines_vat_consistency_check
billing_document_lines_vat_consistency_c.value:
"billing_document_lines"."net_amount" >= 0
      and "billing_document_lines"."tax_amount" >= 0
      and "billing_document_lines"."gross_amount" = "billing_document_lines"."net_amount" + "billing_document_lines"."tax_amount"
      and (("billing_document_lines"."vat_treatment" = 'STANDARD' and "billing_document_lines"."vat_rate" > 0)
        or ("billing_document_lines"."vat_treatment" <> 'STANDARD' and "billing_document_lines"."vat_rate" = 0))

billing_document_recoverable_claims_rele.name: billing_document_recoverable_claims_release_consistency_check
billing_document_recoverable_claims_rele.value:
("billing_document_recoverable_claims"."released_at" is null and "billing_document_recoverable_claims"."released_by" is null and "billing_document_recoverable_claims"."release_reason" is null)
      or ("billing_document_recoverable_claims"."released_at" is not null and "billing_document_recoverable_claims"."release_reason" is not null)

billing_document_trip_claims_release_act.name: billing_document_trip_claims_release_actor_check
billing_document_trip_claims_release_act.value: "billing_document_trip_claims"."released_by" is null or "billing_document_trip_claims"."released_at" is not null

billing_document_trip_claims_release_con.name: billing_document_trip_claims_release_consistency_check
billing_document_trip_claims_release_con.value:
("billing_document_trip_claims"."released_at" is null and "billing_document_trip_claims"."released_by" is null and "billing_document_trip_claims"."release_reason" is null)
      or ("billing_document_trip_claims"."released_at" is not null and "billing_document_trip_claims"."release_reason" is not null)

credit_override_requests_amounts_nonneg_.name: credit_override_requests_amounts_nonneg_check
credit_override_requests_amounts_nonneg_.value: "credit_override_requests"."proposed_amount" >= 0 and "credit_override_requests"."outstanding_amount" >= 0 and "credit_override_requests"."approved_commitment_amount" >= 0 and "credit_override_requests"."total_exposure" >= 0 and "credit_override_requests"."credit_limit" > 0 and "credit_override_requests"."over_limit_amount" >= 0 and "credit_override_requests"."over_limit_ratio" >= 0

credit_override_requests_scope_check.name: credit_override_requests_scope_check
credit_override_requests_scope_check.value: ("credit_override_requests"."scope_type" = 'SHIPMENT' and "credit_override_requests"."shipment_id" is not null and "credit_override_requests"."expires_at" is null) or ("credit_override_requests"."scope_type" = 'EXPIRY' and "credit_override_requests"."shipment_id" is null and "credit_override_requests"."expires_at" is not null)

credit_override_requests_approval_actor_.name: credit_override_requests_approval_actor_check
credit_override_requests_approval_actor_.value: "credit_override_requests"."status" <> 'APPROVED' or ("credit_override_requests"."approved_by" is not null and "credit_override_requests"."approved_at" is not null)

credit_override_requests_rejection_actor.name: credit_override_requests_rejection_actor_check
credit_override_requests_rejection_actor.value: "credit_override_requests"."status" <> 'REJECTED' or ("credit_override_requests"."rejected_by" is not null and "credit_override_requests"."rejected_at" is not null and "credit_override_requests"."rejection_reason" is not null)

customers_active_tax_code_uniq_idx.name: customers_active_tax_code_uniq_idx
customers_active_tax_code_uniq_idx.where: "customers"."deleted_at" is null and nullif(btrim("customers"."tax_code"), '') is not null

dispatch_handoffs_acceptance_actor_check.name: dispatch_handoffs_acceptance_actor_check
dispatch_handoffs_acceptance_actor_check.value: "dispatch_handoffs"."status" <> 'ACCEPTED' or "dispatch_handoffs"."version" = 1 or ("dispatch_handoffs"."accepted_by" is not null and "dispatch_handoffs"."resolved_at" is not null)

drivers_active_user_uniq_idx.name: drivers_active_user_uniq_idx
drivers_active_user_uniq_idx.where: "drivers"."user_id" is not null and "drivers"."deleted_at" is null

governance_actions_active_subject_id_uni.name: governance_actions_active_subject_id_uniq
governance_actions_active_subject_id_uni.where: "governance_actions"."subject_id" is not null and "governance_actions"."action_kind" not in ('TRIP_AR_ADJUSTMENT', 'TRIP_REOPEN') and "governance_actions"."status" in ('PENDING_CHECK', 'PENDING_APPROVAL', 'RETURNED_FOR_EVIDENCE')

governance_actions_distinct_approver_che.name: governance_actions_distinct_approver_check
governance_actions_distinct_approver_che.value: "governance_actions"."approver_id" is null or ("governance_actions"."approver_id" <> "governance_actions"."maker_id" and ("governance_actions"."checker_id" is null or "governance_actions"."approver_id" <> "governance_actions"."checker_id"))

master_import_batches_apply_attribution_.name: master_import_batches_apply_attribution_check
master_import_batches_apply_attribution_.value:
("master_import_batches"."status" = 'APPLIED' and "master_import_batches"."applied_by" is not null and "master_import_batches"."applied_at" is not null)
      or ("master_import_batches"."status" <> 'APPLIED' and "master_import_batches"."applied_by" is null and "master_import_batches"."applied_at" is null)

master_import_rows_reason_check.name: master_import_rows_reason_check
master_import_rows_reason_check.value: "master_import_row_results"."classification" <> 'BLOCKED' or ("master_import_row_results"."reason_code" is not null and "master_import_row_results"."redacted_reason" is not null)

salesperson_assignments_shipment_active_.name: salesperson_assignments_shipment_active_uniq
salesperson_assignments_shipment_active_.where: "salesperson_assignments"."shipment_id" is not null and "salesperson_assignments"."effective_to" is null

shipment_fulfillments_active_container_u.name: shipment_fulfillments_active_container_uniq_idx
shipment_fulfillments_active_container_u.where: "shipment_fulfillments"."shipment_container_id" is not null and "shipment_fulfillments"."canceled_at" is null

shipment_fulfillments_type_container_che.name: shipment_fulfillments_type_container_check
shipment_fulfillments_type_container_che.value:
("shipment_fulfillments"."cargo_mode" = 'FCL' and "shipment_fulfillments"."fulfillment_type" = 'FCL_CONTAINER'
          and "shipment_fulfillments"."shipment_container_id" is not null)
      or ("shipment_fulfillments"."cargo_mode" = 'LCL' and "shipment_fulfillments"."fulfillment_type" = 'LCL_SHIPMENT'
          and "shipment_fulfillments"."shipment_container_id" is null)

shipment_fulfillments_cancel_attribution.name: shipment_fulfillments_cancel_attribution_check
shipment_fulfillments_cancel_attribution.value:
("shipment_fulfillments"."canceled_at" is null and "shipment_fulfillments"."canceled_by" is null and "shipment_fulfillments"."cancellation_reason" is null
          and "shipment_fulfillments"."cancellation_disposition" is null and "shipment_fulfillments"."replacement_fulfillment_id" is null
          and "shipment_fulfillments"."not_required_approved_by" is null and "shipment_fulfillments"."not_required_approved_at" is null
          and "shipment_fulfillments"."not_required_reason" is null)
      or ("shipment_fulfillments"."canceled_at" is not null and "shipment_fulfillments"."canceled_by" is not null
          and length(btrim("shipment_fulfillments"."cancellation_reason")) > 0)

shipment_fulfillments_disposition_check.name: shipment_fulfillments_disposition_check
shipment_fulfillments_disposition_check.value:
"shipment_fulfillments"."cancellation_disposition" is null
      or ("shipment_fulfillments"."cancellation_disposition" = 'REPLACED' and "shipment_fulfillments"."replacement_fulfillment_id" is not null
          and "shipment_fulfillments"."not_required_approved_by" is null and "shipment_fulfillments"."not_required_approved_at" is null
          and "shipment_fulfillments"."not_required_reason" is null)
      or ("shipment_fulfillments"."cancellation_disposition" = 'NOT_REQUIRED' and "shipment_fulfillments"."replacement_fulfillment_id" is null
          and "shipment_fulfillments"."not_required_approved_by" is not null and "shipment_fulfillments"."not_required_approved_at" is not null
          and length(btrim("shipment_fulfillments"."not_required_reason")) > 0)

treasury_movements_receipt_posted_uniq.name: treasury_movements_receipt_posted_uniq
treasury_movements_receipt_posted_uniq.where: "treasury_movements"."payment_receipt_id" is not null and "treasury_movements"."status" = 'POSTED' and "treasury_movements"."reversal_of_id" is null

treasury_movements_ledger_posted_uniq.name: treasury_movements_ledger_posted_uniq
treasury_movements_ledger_posted_uniq.where: "treasury_movements"."ledger_entry_id" is not null and "treasury_movements"."status" = 'POSTED' and "treasury_movements"."reversal_of_id" is null

treasury_movements_exactly_one_source_ch.name: treasury_movements_exactly_one_source_check
treasury_movements_exactly_one_source_ch.value:
(case when "treasury_movements"."payment_receipt_id" is null then 0 else 1 end)
      + (case when "treasury_movements"."ledger_entry_id" is null then 0 else 1 end) = 1

trip_expenses_recoverable_split_nonnegat.name: trip_expenses_recoverable_split_nonnegative_check
trip_expenses_recoverable_split_nonnegat.value:
("trip_expenses"."recoverable_principal_amount" is null or "trip_expenses"."recoverable_principal_amount" >= 0)
      and ("trip_expenses"."service_fee_amount" is null or "trip_expenses"."service_fee_amount" >= 0)

trip_expenses_recoverable_split_consiste.name: trip_expenses_recoverable_split_consistency_check
trip_expenses_recoverable_split_consiste.value:
("trip_expenses"."recoverable_principal_amount" is null and "trip_expenses"."service_fee_amount" is null)
      or ("trip_expenses"."recoverable_principal_amount" is not null and "trip_expenses"."service_fee_amount" is not null
        and "trip_expenses"."recoverable_principal_amount" + "trip_expenses"."service_fee_amount" = "trip_expenses"."sell_amount")

trip_pod_submissions_state_check.name: trip_pod_submissions_state_check
trip_pod_submissions_state_check.value:
("trip_pod_submissions"."status" = 'DRAFT' and "trip_pod_submissions"."submitted_by" is null and "trip_pod_submissions"."submitted_at" is null
          and "trip_pod_submissions"."reviewed_by" is null and "trip_pod_submissions"."reviewed_at" is null and "trip_pod_submissions"."rejection_reason" is null)
      or ("trip_pod_submissions"."status" = 'SUBMITTED' and "trip_pod_submissions"."submitted_by" is not null and "trip_pod_submissions"."submitted_at" is not null
          and "trip_pod_submissions"."reviewed_by" is null and "trip_pod_submissions"."reviewed_at" is null and "trip_pod_submissions"."rejection_reason" is null)
      or ("trip_pod_submissions"."status" = 'ACCEPTED' and "trip_pod_submissions"."submitted_by" is not null and "trip_pod_submissions"."submitted_at" is not null
          and "trip_pod_submissions"."reviewed_by" is not null and "trip_pod_submissions"."reviewed_at" is not null and "trip_pod_submissions"."rejection_reason" is null)
      or ("trip_pod_submissions"."status" = 'REJECTED' and "trip_pod_submissions"."submitted_by" is not null and "trip_pod_submissions"."submitted_at" is not null
          and "trip_pod_submissions"."reviewed_by" is not null and "trip_pod_submissions"."reviewed_at" is not null
          and length(btrim("trip_pod_submissions"."rejection_reason")) > 0)

trip_pod_submissions_supersession_check.name: trip_pod_submissions_supersession_check
trip_pod_submissions_supersession_check.value:
("trip_pod_submissions"."submission_version" = 1 and "trip_pod_submissions"."supersedes_submission_id" is null)
      or ("trip_pod_submissions"."submission_version" > 1 and "trip_pod_submissions"."supersedes_submission_id" is not null)

trips_shipment_without_fulfillment_live_.name: trips_shipment_without_fulfillment_live_uniq
trips_shipment_without_fulfillment_live_.where: "trips"."shipment_id" is not null and "trips"."fulfillment_id" is null and "trips"."status" <> 'CANCELED'

trips_shipment_fulfillment_presence_chec.name: trips_shipment_fulfillment_presence_check
trips_shipment_fulfillment_presence_chec.value: "trips"."fulfillment_id" is null or "trips"."shipment_id" is not null

trips_active_trip_pair_presence_check.name: trips_active_trip_pair_presence_check
trips_active_trip_pair_presence_check.value:
("trips"."active_trip_pair_id" is null and "trips"."active_trip_pair_order" is null)
      or ("trips"."active_trip_pair_id" is not null and "trips"."active_trip_pair_order" is not null)
